riskiest_assumption.text: Given feasibility axis score 2.0 (dvf:12), the riskiest assumption is that integrating global-local attention blocks into a transformer decoder separator can maintain high audio-visual separation quality while achieving significant parameter and MAC reductions in real-world scenarios.

mvp.text: Implement a technical proof of concept using existing packages (pkg:transformers, pkg:deepspeed) to build a lightweight encoder-decoder separator incorporating global-local attention layers, and evaluate its parameter count and inference speed on benchmark audio-visual speech separation datasets.
mvp.type: technical proof of concept from existing packages

success_metric.text: Achieve a proposed threshold of at least 50 percent fewer parameters and a proposed threshold of more than 2.4x reduction in MACs compared to the baseline while maintaining competitive separation quality.

kill_criteria.text: If the model fails to achieve a proposed threshold of 6x faster GPU inference speed or incurs higher computational cost than existing preprocessing steps, the approach is killed.

open_source.use: Provides foundational transformer model definitions and layers for building the encoder-decoder separator.
Accelerates training and inference for memory-efficient execution of transformer-based architectures.

to_build.text: A custom global-local attention layer module that can be integrated into each layer of the encoder-decoder separator to capture multi-scale dependencies.
